title: alstroemeria werdermannii subsp. flavicans
intro: Alstroemeria werdermannii subsp. flavicans, commonly known as the yellow Peruvian lily, is a species of flowering plant in the family Alstroemeriaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alstroemeria werdermannii subsp. flavicans include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
